summary: Fixed TOCTOU race condition in _ensure_parent_directory by removing redundant exists() check and using exist_ok=True in mkdir() call
fix_description: Changed parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False) to parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) and removed the redundant parent.exists() check. The exist_ok=True flag handles the TOCTOU race condition atomically at the OS level, preventing FileExistsError when multiple processes try to create the same directory concurrently.
risks: Minimal - the change makes the operation more robust by handling race conditions. No functional behavior changes for single-process use cases.
